paragraphs: Core Laboratories Inc. is a Delaware corporation. We were established in 1936 and are one of the world's leading providers of proprietary and patented reservoir description and production enhancement services and products to the oil and gas industry, primarily through client relationships with many of the world's major, national and independent oil companies. These services and products can enable our clients to evaluate and improve reservoir performance and increase oil and gas recovery from their new and existing fields. We make measurements on reservoir rocks, reservoir fluids (crude oil, natural gas and water) and their derived products. In addition, we assist clients in evaluating subsurface targets associated with Carbon Capture and Sequestration ("CCS") projects or initiatives. We have over 70 offices in more than 50 countries and have approximately 3,300 employees.

On May 1, 2023, Core Laboratories N.V. completed its previously announced redomestication transaction (the "Redomestication Transaction"), which through a series of steps, resulted in the merger of Core Laboratories N.V., a holding company in the Netherlands, with and into Core Laboratories Luxembourg S.A., a public limited liability company incorporated under the laws of Luxembourg, with Core Laboratories Luxembourg S.A. surviving, and subsequently the migration of Core Laboratories Luxembourg S.A. out of Luxembourg and its domestication as Core Laboratories Inc., a Delaware corporation. See Note 1 - Description of Business of the Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements.

References to "Core Laboratories", "Core Lab", "the Company", "we", "our", "us" and similar phrases are used throughout this Annual Report on Form 10-K (this "Form 10-K") and relate collectively to Core Laboratories Inc. and its consolidated affiliates.

Our business strategy is to provide advanced technologies that improve reservoir performance by (i) continuing the development of proprietary technologies through client-driven research and development, (ii) expanding the services and products offered throughout our global network of offices and (iii) acquiring complementary technologies that add key technologies or market presence and enhance existing services and products.

We conduct research and development to meet the needs of our clients who are continually seeking new services and technologies to lower their costs of finding, developing and producing oil and gas. While the aggregate number of wells being drilled per year fluctuates in response to market conditions, oil and gas producers have, on a proportional basis, increased expenditures on technology services to improve their understanding of the reservoir, increased production of oil and gas from their producing fields, and more recently, CCS projects. We intend to continue concentrating our efforts on services and technologies that help our clients reduce risk by evaluating geologic and engineering aspects of subsurface stratigraphic targets to improve reservoir performance and increase oil and gas recovery, as well as CCS projects and other projects directed at the global objective to reduce carbon emissions.

Another component of our business strategy is to broaden the spectrum of services and products offered to our clients on a global basis. We intend to continue using our worldwide network of offices to offer our services and products that have been developed internally or obtained through acquisitions. This global emphasis allows us to increase our revenue and enhance our profit through efficient utilization of our worldwide network.
We continually review potential acquisitions to add key services and technologies, enhance market presence or complement existing business.
More information relating to any significant acquisitions is included in Note 3 - Acquisitions and Divestures of the Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements.
We derive our revenue from services and product sales to clients primarily in the oil and gas and associated industries.

We operate our business in two segments. These complementary operating segments provide different services and products and utilize different technologies for evaluating and improving reservoir performance and increasing oil and gas recovery from new and existing fields. Disclosure relating to the operations and financial information of these operating segments is included in Note 20 - Segment Reporting and Other Disaggregated Information of the Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements.

• Reservoir Description: Encompasses the characterization of petroleum reservoir rock, and reservoir fluids samples to increase production and improve recovery of crude oil and natural gas from our clients' reservoirs. We provide laboratory-based analytical and field services to characterize properties of crude oil and crude oil-derived products to the oil and gas industry. Services associated with these fluids include determining the quality and measuring the quantity of the reservoir fluids and their derived products, such as gasoline, diesel and biofuels. We also provide proprietary and joint industry studies based on these types of analyses and manufacture associated laboratory equipment. In addition, we provide reservoir description capabilities that support various activities associated with energy transition projects, including services that support carbon capture, utilization and storage, geothermal projects, and the evaluation and appraisal of mining activities around lithium and other elements necessary for energy storage.

• Production Enhancement: Includes services and manufactured products associated with reservoir well completions, perforations, stimulation, production and well abandonment. We provide integrated diagnostic services to evaluate and monitor the effectiveness of well completions and to develop solutions aimed at increasing the effectiveness of enhanced oil recovery projects.
We offer our services worldwide through a global network of offices. Services accounted for 76%, 74% and 73% of our revenue for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

We manufacture products primarily in four facilities for distribution on a global basis. Product sales accounted for 24%, 26% and 27% of our revenue for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

headings: Risk factors associated with the industry in which we operate
Any cost reduction initiatives that Core Lab undertakes may not deliver the results it expects, and these actions may adversely affect its business.
Risk factors associated with our international presence
We depend on the results of our international operations, which expose us to risks inherent in doing business abroad.

Our operations may be adversely affected by sanctions, export controls, and similar measures targeting Russia and other countries and territories as well as other responses to Russia's military conflict in Ukraine.
Tariffs and other trade measures could adversely affect our business, results of operations, financial position and cash flows.
Our results of operations may be significantly affected by foreign currency exchange rate risk.
Risk factors associated with technology advancement
If we are not able to develop or acquire new services or products or our services and products become technologically obsolete, our results of operations may be adversely affected.
If we are unable to obtain patents, licenses and other intellectual property rights covering our services and products, our operating results may be adversely affected.
We are subject to cyber security risks. A cyber incident could occur and result in information theft, data corruption, operational disruption and/or financial loss.
Risk factors associated with our supply chain, resources, liquidity and capital management
We are subject to the risk of supplier concentration.
We may be unable to attract and retain skilled and technically knowledgeable employees, which could adversely affect our business.
Risk factors associated with health, safety and the environment
We are subject to a variety of environmental and occupational safety and health laws and regulations, which may result in increased costs and significant liability to our business.
areas in which our clients' oil and natural gas production may occur and reduce demand for our services, which may adversely affect our business and results of operations.
Increasing attention to sustainability and corporate responsibility matters may impact our business.
We are subject to the physical effects of climate change, which may adversely affect our business and results of operations.
Risk factors associated with our common stock
Provisions in our certificate of incorporation, bylaws and Delaware law may discourage a takeover attempt even if a takeover might be beneficial to our stockholders.
paragraphs: Our forward-looking statements are based on assumptions that we believe to be reasonable but that may not prove to be accurate. All of our forward-looking information is, therefore, subject to risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ materially from the results expected. All known material risks and uncertainties are discussed below.

As business conditions change, the Company may need to implement cost-cutting measures that may adversely affect its business. These cost-cutting measures may include reductions in various expenses, including the quarterly dividend, base salaries of senior executives and employees, and annual capital expenditures, as well as implementation of temporary employee furloughs, workforce reductions, and other measures to reduce corporate and operating costs.

These cost-cutting initiatives could result in disruptions to Core Lab's operations. Any such measures could also negatively impact Core Lab's business by delaying the introduction of new products or technologies, interrupting the effective deployment of existing products and services, or impacting employee retention. In addition, there can be no assurance that these cost controls will closely correlate with reduced operating activity. If Core Lab's operating costs are higher than expected, or if it does not maintain adequate control of its costs, Core Lab's results of operations will suffer. If Core Lab is unable to mitigate these or other potential risks related to its initiatives, it may disrupt Core Lab's business or could have a material adverse effect on its financial condition and results of operations.

Downturns in the oil and gas industry, or in the oilfield services business, or lower success rates of our clients' exploration and drilling efforts, may have a material adverse effect on our financial condition or results of operations.

The oil and gas industry is highly cyclical and demand for the majority of our oilfield services and products is substantially dependent on the level of expenditures by the oil and gas industry for the exploration, development and production of crude oil and natural gas reserves, which are sensitive to oil and natural gas prices and generally dependent on the industry's view of future oil and gas prices. During periods of higher, stable prices, our clients generally invest more in capital expenditures and, during periods of lower or volatile commodity prices, they tend to invest less. Consequently, the level of capital expenditures by our clients impacts the demand for our services and products.

paragraphs: Core Laboratories Inc. 為一間德拉瓦州公司。我們於1936年成立，是全球領先的油氣產業專利及專有技術的儲層描述與產能提升服務與產品供應商之一，主要透過與全球許多主要、國家及獨立油公司客戶的關係提供服務與產品。這些服務與產品可協助客戶評估與改善儲層表現，並提高其新舊油田的油氣回收率。我們會對儲層岩石、儲層流體（原油、天然氣與水）及其衍生產品進行測量。此外，我們協助客戶評估與碳封存（"CCS"）計畫或專案相關的地下目標。我們在全球超過50個國家設有超過70個辦事處，並擁有約3,300名員工。

Core Laboratories N.V. 於2023年5月1日完成其先前公告的重 domiciliation 交易（"Redomestication Transaction"），透過一系列步驟，使Core Laboratories N.V. 這間荷蘭的控股公司與Core Laboratories Luxembourg S.A. 合併，Core Laboratories Luxembourg S.A. 為根據盧森堡法律設立的公開有限公司，並由Core Laboratories Luxembourg S.A. 繼續存續，隨後Core Laboratories Luxembourg S.A. 從盧森堡遷移並設立為Core Laboratories Inc.，一間德拉瓦州公司。詳情請參見財務會計彙編附註第1項－業務說明。
本年度報告表10-K（本「Form 10-K」）中，"Core Laboratories"、"Core Lab"、"the Company"、"we"、"our"、"us" 及類似詞彙均用於文中，並 collectively 指Core Laboratories Inc. 及其合併附屬公司。
我們的業務策略是提供先進技術以改善儲層表現，包括（i）透過客戶驅動的研究與發展持續發展專有技術，（ii）擴展我們全球辦事處所提供的服務與產品，以及（iii）取得補充技術以增加關鍵技術或市場存在感並提升現有服務與產品。

我們進行研究與發展以符合客戶的需求，這些客戶持續尋求新的服務與技術以降低尋找、開發與生產油氣的成本。雖然每年鑽井井數的總數會因市場條件而波動，但油氣生產商在比例上已增加對技術服務的支出，以提升對儲層的瞭解、提高其生產油田的油氣產量，以及近期的CCS專案。我們意圖持續專注於協助客戶降低風險的服務與技術，評估地下地層目標的地質與工程方面以改善儲層表現並提高油氣回收率，以及CCS專案及其他專注於全球減少碳排放目標的專案。
我們業務策略的另一個組成部分是擴展我們在全球範圍內為客戶提供的服務與產品種類。我們意圖持續利用我們全球辦事處網路，提供我們內部開發或透過收購取得的服務與產品。這種全球重點使我們能透過有效利用全球網路來增加收入並提升利潤。
我們持續評估潛在收購案，以增加關鍵服務與技術、強化市場存在感或補足現有業務。
有關任何重大收購的更多資訊，請參見財務會計彙編附註第3項－收購與出售。
本公司營業收入來自於為客戶提供的服務及產品銷售，客戶主要來自石油與天然氣及相關產業。
本公司業務分為兩個應報告分部。這些互補的運營分部提供不同的服務與產品，並使用不同的技術來評估與改善儲層表現，並提高新舊油田的石油與天然氣回收率。關於這些運營分部的運營及財務資訊揭露，請參閱財務報表附註第 20 項 - 分部報告及其他 disaggregated 資訊。

• 儲層描述：涵蓋對石油儲層岩石及儲層流體樣本的特性分析，以提高客戶儲層的生產量並改善原油與天然氣的回收率。本公司為石油與天然氣產業提供基於實驗室分析及現場服務，用以分析原油及其衍生產品的特性。與這些流體相關的服務包括確定流體品質並測量其數量及其衍生產品，如汽油、柴油及生物燃料。本公司亦根據此類分析提供專有及行業合作研究，並製造相關實驗室設備。此外，本公司亦提供支援能源轉型專案各項活動的儲層描述能力，包括支援碳捕捉、利用與儲存、地熱專案，以及評估與評價鋰及其他用於能源儲存必要元素的礦業活動之服務。
• 生產增效：包含與儲層井完井、射孔、壓裂、生產及井棄置相關的服務與製造產品。本公司提供整合診斷服務，用以評估與監測井完井的成效，並發展解決方案以提高增產油藏專案的成效。
本公司透過全球辦事處網路在全球提供服務。服務收入佔本公司營業收入的 76%、74% 及 73%，分別為 2025 年 12 月 31 日、2024 年 12 月 31 日及 2023 年 12 月 31 日之會計年度。
本公司主要在四個廠區製造產品，用以全球分銷。產品銷售佔本公司營業收入的 24%、26% 及 27%，分別為 2025 年 12 月 31 日、2024 年 12 月 31 日及 2023 年 12 月 31 日之會計年度。

headings: 與我們所從事產業相關的風險因素
Core Lab 所進行的任何成本降低措施可能無法達成預期結果，且這些行動可能對其業務產生不利影響。
與我們國際業務相關的風險因素
我們依賴國際業務的成果，這使我們面臨在海外從事業務所固有的風險。
我們的業務可能因針對俄羅斯及其他國家與地區以及對俄羅斯在烏克蘭軍事衝突的回應而實施的制裁、出口管制及其他措施而受到不利影響。
關稅及其他貿易措施可能對我們的業務、營運結果、財務狀況及現金流產生不利影響。
我們的營運結果可能因外幣匯率風險而受到顯著影響。
與科技進步相關的風險因素
若本公司無法開發或取得新的服務或產品，或本公司之服務及產品成為技術上過時，則本公司之營運結果可能受到不利影響。
若本公司無法取得涵蓋本公司服務及產品之專利、許可證及其他智慧財產權，則本公司之營運結果可能受到不利影響。
本公司面臨網路安全風險。可能發生網路事件，導致資訊竊取、資料毀損、營運中斷及/或財務損失。
與本公司供應鏈、資源、流動性及資本管理相關之風險因素
本公司面臨供應商集中之風險。
本公司可能無法吸引並留住具專業技能及技術知識之員工，此情況可能對本公司業務造成不利影響。
與健康、安全及環境相關之風險因素
本公司面臨種種環境及職業安全與健康法規，此等法規可能導致本公司營運成本增加及產生重大負擔。
客戶油氣與天然氣開採可能發生之區域及降低我們服務需求之情形，可能不利於本公司業務與營運成果。
對永續性與企業責任之關注增加，可能影響本公司業務。
本公司受氣候變遷之實體影響，可能不利於本公司業務與營運成果。
與本公司普通股相關之風險因素
本公司章程、規章及特拉華州法律之規定，可能阻卻收購行動，即使該收購行動對股東而言可能為益處。
paragraphs: 本公司之展望性陳述係基於本公司認為合理之假設，但這些假設未必準確。因此，本公司所有展望性資訊均受到風險與不確定性之影響，可能導致實際結果與預期結果有重大差異。所有已知之重大風險與不確定性均於下文討論。
隨著營運環境變動，本公司可能需要實施節省成本措施，這些措施可能對本公司業務造成不利影響。這些節省成本措施可能包括減少各項費用，包括季節性股息、高階主管與員工之基本薪資，以及年度資本支出，以及實施臨時員工停薪留職、人力精簡及其他措施以降低公司與營運成本。

這些節省成本措施可能導致 Core Lab 之營運中斷。任何此類措施也可能透過延遲新產品或技術之推出、中斷現有產品與服務之有效部署，或影響員工留存，而對 Core Lab 之業務造成負面影響。此外，無法保證這些成本控制措施會與營運活動之減少密切相關。若 Core Lab 之營運成本高於預期，或未能維持適當的成本控制，則 Core Lab 之營運結果將受影響。若 Core Lab 無法緩解這些或其他與其措施相關之潛在風險，可能幹擾 Core Lab 之業務，或對其財務狀況與營運結果造成重大不利影響。
油氣產業或油氣服務產業之衰退，或客戶之探勘與鑽井成效率降低，可能對本公司之財務狀況或營運結果造成重大不利影響。
油氣產業具有高度週期性，本公司絕 majority 之油氣服務與產品需求， substantially 依賴油氣產業對探勘、開發與生產原油與天然氣儲備之支出，而此支出對原油與天然氣價格高度敏感，並通常取決於產業對未來原油與天然氣價格之看法。影響本公司服務與產品供應與需求之因素眾多，總結如下：
▪ 總體經濟營運環境，包括原油與天然氣之市場價格及對未來價格之預期
